initial_plan.can_answer: yes: the data can describe each weekday's share of police-reported crashes, but not crash risk by weekday
initial_plan.metric: percentage of included crash rows on each weekday
initial_plan.denominator: all included crash rows dated in 2013–2025
initial_plan.population: crashes with a usable crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
initial_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive; whether endpoints are complete will be checked
initial_plan.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday

data_check.facts: check_2.csv records rows in each calendar year from 2013 to 2025, date coverage from January 1 through December 31 in every year, and zero NULL crash_date rows in the source. crash_date is typed DATE, so empty/unknown text and impossible calendar dates are not representable; no default date or unknown marker is documented for this column.
data_check.meaning_and_decisions: All 13 requested years are complete calendar years. No included crash rows are dropped for missing crash_date, and every included row maps to one weekday. Keep all rows and disclose that shares are of police-reported crash records, not exposure-adjusted risk. No plan change.

final_plan.can_answer: yes: describes weekday shares among police-reported crash records, not crash risk
final_plan.metric: percentage of all crash rows in 2013–2025 assigned to each weekday
final_plan.denominator: all rows with crash_date in 2013–2025 inclusive
final_plan.population: all rows with crash_date in 2013–2025 inclusive
final_plan.years: all complete calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
final_plan.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday
final_plan.limitations: Zero source rows have NULL crash_date; DATE values cannot encode empty/unknown text or impossible dates, and no default or unknown marker is documented. No rows are excluded for the checked field. Shares describe police-reported crash records rather than traffic exposure or per-trip risk; pooling years weights each year by its observed row total.
